name: com.atommerce.maca_android_sdk.ui.view.main.view.MyCouponSelectActivity
description: After a user selects a coupon in the Mindcafe Android SDK from Atommerce, this screen lists counselors who accept that coupon. Selecting a counselor opens that counselor page.
disableEffect: Users cannot see or choose a counselor eligible for the selected coupon, interrupting that coupon use flow.
